{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling possible errors
# Use pd.to_numeric with errors='coerce' to convert invalid entries to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors (i.e., NaN values)
conversion_errors = df['revenue_numeric'].isnull().sum()

# Verify that all revenue values are now numeric
# Also check that the 'status' column contains only 'completed' and 'refunded'
status_unique = df['status'].unique()

# Check for any rows with revenue_numeric NaN
invalid_rows = df[df['revenue_numeric'].isnull()]

# Display results
conversion_errors, status_unique, invalid_rows"}
